name: @lodado/game-interface-design-plugin
description: Mobile-web game planning, player flows, HUDs, game feel, optional Figma UI, FSD/ECS Three.js greybox prototypes, lint-gated pixel sprite animation, and lifelike cat behavior with a trace check.

scripts.pack:zip: mkdir -p dist && git -C "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" archive --format=zip --prefix=game-interface-design/ -o "$PWD/dist/game-interface-design-$npm_package_version.zip" HEAD:packages/game-interface-design
